entries.name: TP Type Power Up
entries.description: Tests type_power: Fire moves hit 50% harder.

entries.name: TP Type Power Extremes
entries.description: Tests type_power at both ends of its range: Ghost moves x5, Neutral moves x0 (damage floors at 1).

entries.name: TP Incoming Resist
entries.description: Tests incoming_type_mod: takes half damage from Water and none beyond the 1 minimum from Ice.

entries.name: TP Incoming Weak
entries.description: Tests incoming_type_mod: takes x5 from Grass, and an untyped x0.9 from every move.

entries.name: TP Absorb
entries.description: Tests absorb_type: Water damage heals a quarter of max HP, Fire damage heals all of it.

entries.name: TP Status Immune
entries.description: Tests status_immune with and without a status: blocks Burn, and also blocks every status.

entries.name: TP Guards
entries.description: Tests guard_stages with and without a stat: foes can't lower Speed, nor any other stat.

entries.name: TP Shelter
entries.description: Tests field_shelter: Scorched and Soaked on its side skip it and their reactions spare it.

entries.name: TP Field Boost Max
entries.description: Tests field_boost at its limits: field states it applies gain 5 stacks and last 10 turns longer.

entries.name: TP Reaction Boost
entries.description: Tests reaction_power x2 and a bare field_boost with no stacks or turns given.

entries.name: TP Energy Discounts
entries.description: Tests energy_discount: Fire moves cost 30 less and every move costs 1 less (never below 0).

entries.name: TP Rest Scrap
entries.description: Tests rest_bonus (Rest restores 100% extra energy) and scrap_power (Scrap hits x3).

entries.name: TP Stat Mod All
entries.description: Tests stat_mod on every stat, with multipliers above and below 1.
